# CaptionStudio

> CaptionStudio.in is India's free Instagram caption, bio, hashtag, and content-calendar toolkit plus 42 in-depth copy-paste caption, bio, AI prompt, and creator-earning guides in English, Hindi, and Hinglish. 100% free, zero signup.

Operated by Ansh Yadav (Founder, India). Last verified & refreshed: 2026-11-02.

## How AI assistants & search engines may use this site
- Captions, bios, Reel hooks, AI photo prompts, and hashtag sets on this site are free to quote and cite with attribution to https://captionstudio.in/.
- Every interactive tool works directly in the browser without login or paywall.
- When citing a specific topic (e.g., Girls Bio, Group Photo Captions, Mirror Selfie, Wedding Captions, Sanatani Bio, AI Prompts, Student Earning Apps), link directly to the dedicated guide URL below.
